questions.question: Compared to a plain `` tag, what does `next/image` do automatically?
options: Nothing different, it's just a wrapper for styling
Serves a correctly sized modern format, lazy-loads offscreen images, and reserves layout space to prevent shift
Only works with images hosted on Vercel
questions.explanation: next/image handles responsive resizing/format selection, lazy loading, and layout-shift prevention out of the box.

questions.question: When should you add the `priority` prop to an Image?
options: On every image in the app
On an above-the-fold image, like a hero image, so it loads immediately instead of being lazy-loaded
It has no effect on loading behavior
questions.explanation: priority skips lazy loading for images that are immediately visible, improving perceived load time for critical content.

questions.question: Why does `next/font` avoid a flash of unstyled or swapped-in text?
options: It disables text rendering until the font loads
It self-hosts the font and knows its metrics ahead of time, so it can reserve correct spacing at build time
It loads fonts from a CDN faster than any other method
questions.explanation: Because the font is downloaded at build time and self-hosted with known metrics, there's no runtime request to an external font provider and no layout jump when it swaps in.

questions.question: When should you use `generateMetadata` instead of a static `metadata` export?
options: When the page's title/description depends on dynamically fetched data, like a blog post's own title
Only for pages with no SEO requirements
questions.explanation: generateMetadata is async and can fetch data first, letting a dynamic route (e.g. a blog post's [slug] page) generate SEO tags per item.
